principle: Mouse, keyboard, and phone are three mode-native interaction languages over one Prompt Kit product model. Equivalent intent converges on the same semantic action and state owner; phone is not resized desktop chrome.

forbidden: second mobile state machine or command registry

capabilities.mouse: A–E profile tabs and filter rails

capabilities.phone: More → Search (intentional focus; software keyboard only for text entry)
capabilities.proof: mobile quick controls markers; keyboard / binding in prompt-kit.js

capabilities.keyboard: reachable via finder open from Hotkeys/Tutorial surfaces
Favorites profile slot (default C) + favorite prompt sequences

capabilities.phone: Explicit Open button on a prompt card; Go to P# does not auto-open detail

capabilities.keyboard: Space on focused card; configured/recommended prompt sequences (copy + reveal)
capabilities.phone: Tap/click any non-control prompt-card surface; explicit Copy remains available; detail Copy exists only after deliberate Open
capabilities.proof: prompt-kit-interactions whole-card touch copy + mobile browser proof

capabilities.capability: Locate known prompt ID without forcing prompt detail
capabilities.mouse: no dedicated known-ID digit grammar; locate the card normally
capabilities.keyboard: digit sequences reveal the card as part of copy-known; no open-by-digits path
capabilities.phone: Go to P# handle (P prefix shown; type digits only) → reveal and instant-snap the canonical card with detail closed
capabilities.state_owner: active filters + prompt-card viewport/focus; promptDetailOverlay remains closed
capabilities.note: Mode separation applies to locator grammar, not terminal value: phone Go to P# lands on the card; explicit Open alone owns detail.

capabilities.mouse: no dedicated known-ID digit grammar; Copy after locating the card

capabilities.phone: Go to P# → tap/click any non-control area of the snapped prompt card; canonical copyPrompt runs without detail
capabilities.state_owner: canonical prompt identity + clipboard adapter + copy acknowledgement UI
capabilities.proof: hotkey completion + interaction contract + mobile card-tap browser proof
performMobileQuickAction calls toggleRef; no refBtn.click synthesis
mobile quick controls shared action markers

Favorites empty recovery + Go to P# no-match status
capabilities.semantic_action: render empty states / mobile jump status

capabilities.phone: More command sheet (labeled buttons; hotkey config chrome hidden)
capabilities.proof: mobile More panel markers; no swipe-required vocabulary

semantic_convergence_rules: CAPABILITY -> SEMANTIC ACTION -> MODE ADAPTER -> FEEDBACK/STATE
Phone adapters must call canonical owners; synthesizing desktop control clicks is forbidden for essential actions
Hover and double-click may enrich mouse grammar but must not be the only route to essential actions
Gestures accelerate only when a labeled More/button fallback exists
supported_exclusion is allowed when documented; missing phone route is not equivalent to use the desktop control

Known-ID locator grammars are mode-separated, but terminal copy converges on copyPrompt: phone Go to P# snaps to the card then card tap copies; keyboard digits copy+reveal; mouse locates then card click/Copy. Go to P# must not auto-open detail.
proof_ceiling: Static contract and source-marker tests prove mode routes and semantic convergence markers. Chromium 390x844 journeys prove browser geometry/input for tracked paths. Physical Android thumb reach, real software-keyboard feel, OS/browser gesture conflict, and device clipboard UX remain field acceptance gates and are not claimed by this contract.
